_note: Anchor dates default to 2026 since today is 2026-05-12. Edit any date here to shift the plan. Phases are computed in src/lib/phase.ts by checking today against these anchors in order.

anchors.label: Accenture roll-off flag (3 weeks before King Size)

phases.name: Phase 0 — Gradual reduction
phases.focus: Step Habit 1 down. Build Habit 2 state-recognition. Reduce 3&4 to monthly. Install work-pattern interventions.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Final stretch
phases.focus: Final 3&4 date set, communicated to wife. Clinician identified. Substitute pathways defined.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Detox + Accenture exit
phases.focus: Detox weeks 1–4. Accenture flag late September. Sleep disruption / irritability expected.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Detox + King Size start
phases.focus: Hardest phase. First-30-days scope at King Size. Decision velocity rule. External check person engaged.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Late detox
phases.focus: Day 90 markers evaluated continuously. By mid-November you have a read on whether December is on track.

phases.name: Phase 5 — Day 90 decision
phases.focus: Four-question evaluation. Pregnancy attempts begin if all favourable.

phases.name: Re-entry
phases.focus: Habits 3 and 4 do not return. Habit 2 may return ≤2/week with state check. Re-evaluate at Day 180 (~March).

day_90_questions: Did the detox hold? Lapse threshold: ≤2 unplanned instances across 90 days.
What are the four scores doing? Minimum bar: three of four trending correctly.
What is the state of the 3↔4 loop? Activations decreasing in frequency, intensity, or both?
Have the internal questions changed? November vs. June dominant thinking.
